# Description
With the FurnitureMaker Plugin you can easly create and share your custom [FurnitureLib](https://modrinth.com/plugin/furniturelib) Models, you can also easly import Custom BlockDisplay Models or ArmorStand creations from the exporter Website directly in game.

What deos the Furniture Maker need to work
- [https://modrinth.com/plugin/furniturelib](https://modrinth.com/plugin/furniturelib) is required 
  
## Commands
- /furniture create <name>
- /furniture edit <name>
